quotes.en: The journey of a thousand miles begins with a single step.
quotes.zh: 千里之行，始于足下。

quotes.en: It always seems impossible until it is done.
quotes.zh: 在完成之前，一切看起来都不可能。

quotes.en: Success is the sum of small efforts repeated day in and day out.
quotes.zh: 成功是日复一日重复的小努力累积而成。

quotes.en: The best time to plant a tree was twenty years ago. The second best time is now.
quotes.zh: 种树最好的时间是二十年前，其次是现在。

quotes.en: You do not have to be great to start, but you have to start to be great.
quotes.zh: 你不必一开始就很厉害，但要开始才会变厉害。

quotes.en: Small deeds done are better than great deeds planned.
quotes.zh: 做成的小事胜过计划中的大事。

quotes.en: Knowledge is of no value unless you put it into practice.
quotes.zh: 知识若不付诸实践，便毫无价值。

quotes.en: The mind is everything. What you think you become.
quotes.zh: 心即一切，你所想的，终将成为你。

quotes.en: Learning never exhausts the mind.
quotes.zh: 学习永远不会让头脑疲惫。

quotes.en: A different language is a different vision of life.
quotes.zh: 另一种语言，是另一种看待生活的方式。

quotes.en: If you talk to a man in his own language, that goes to his heart.
quotes.zh: 用对方的语言交谈，才能走进他的心。

quotes.en: The limits of my language mean the limits of my world.
quotes.zh: 我的语言的边界，就是我世界的边界。

quotes.en: Do not wait to strike till the iron is hot; but make it hot by striking.
quotes.zh: 别等铁热了再打，要靠打让它变热。

quotes.en: Everything you can imagine is real.
quotes.zh: 你能想象的一切都是真实的。

quotes.en: It is never too late to be what you might have been.
quotes.zh: 成为你本可以成为的人，永远不晚。

quotes.en: The only way to do great work is to love what you do.
quotes.zh: 做出伟大工作的唯一方法，是热爱你所做的事。

quotes.en: Genius is one percent inspiration and ninety-nine percent perspiration.
quotes.zh: 天才是百分之一的灵感加百分之九十九的汗水。

quotes.en: You miss one hundred percent of the shots you never take.
quotes.zh: 你从未投出的球，百分之百不会进。

quotes.en: Stay hungry, stay foolish.
quotes.zh: 求知若饥，虚心若愚。

quotes.en: Fall seven times, stand up eight.
quotes.zh: 跌倒七次，站起八次。

quotes.en: The future depends on what you do today.
quotes.zh: 未来取决于你今天做了什么。

quotes.en: Quality is not an act, it is a habit.
quotes.zh: 优秀不是一种行为，而是一种习惯。

quotes.en: Little by little, one travels far.
quotes.zh: 积少成多，行远自迩。

quotes.en: Doubt kills more dreams than failure ever will.
quotes.zh: 杀死梦想的往往不是失败，而是怀疑。

quotes.en: The secret of getting ahead is getting started.
quotes.zh: 领先的秘诀在于开始。

quotes.en: A word after a word after a word is power.
quotes.zh: 一个词接一个词接一个词，就是力量。

quotes.en: He who moves not forward, goes backward.
quotes.zh: 不进则退。

quotes.en: You are never too old to set another goal or to dream a new dream.
quotes.zh: 设一个新目标、做一场新梦，永远不嫌晚。

quotes.en: Patience is bitter, but its fruit is sweet.
quotes.zh: 忍耐是苦的，但果实是甜的。

quotes.en: What we learn with pleasure we never forget.
quotes.zh: 带着愉悦学到的东西，永远不会忘记。
